system.sibling_key: none (DECODE R1853 is the Gonzaga register of c. 1401-1420; no 1428-30 key)
system.summary: Homophonic substitution in graphic signs with signs for et, con and -rum; x written cx.
system.notes: Look-alikes split on the image: slanted b = i vs rounded b = o; eta vs 9; a stem-o sign = q; o-dagger-o = x. Split 14 Oct 2026 from r1854; P5 is the verso of the 21 Feb letter, photographed upside down.

conditions.human_role: Project-level: DECODE login cookie and /goal target setting. No target-specific intervention.
tools: targets/r1854/solve.py homophonic annealer on lang/ models

solution.what: Fetched R1854 (5 images), the R1853 register (14 images) and DECODE metadata with the saved cookie.
Read the R1853 register keys (Malatesta keys on f. 1, 1406-1419 keys): none match the 1428-30 letters.
Opened all other Mantova records on DECODE (R7858-R7888): 16th-17th century keys.
First-pass transcription of P4 (28 lines) and P5 (3 lines).
Latin anneal on P4 gives readable Latin (post recessum, sollicitabo bullam, galeotam); key applied to P5.
Subagent second pass of P4 and P5 against the image with the key: 209 edits, glyph splits.
P4 and P5 read in full apart from four short spots.

P4 L14: the two signs after 'Patras' (I = i, bo = o, both well attested) are the word's ending: 'archiepiscopus de Patrasio' (Latin form of Italian Patrasso); the doubtful separate word 'io(?)' withdrawn. Letters from the rebuilt key, word division inferred.

Push to 95%: the five DECODE images re-fetched with the saved cookie (PNG, P1 1121x697 px) into img/ (git-ignored); P1 run lines, P2 L15/L28 and P4 L04/L20 cropped at 3-4x and compared with p1v2/p2v3/p4v2. P1 L05 confirms the second-pass signs; P4 L04 'leonebi' (t + = e b) cannot be read as 'Leonelli' from the image; P2 L28 confirms '= 14 j 14 P w 7 &' (l e u e n d e r).
P4 L20 'debert onorio' re-divided: 'Nicolaus cito de Bertonorio debeat recedere' (Bertinoro), every letter as keyed (12 signs); P4 L22 'domicus noster' = dominus noster (one c/n slip, 7 signs).

Split from the R1854 entry under the one-key rule (Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): the record's four letters use four ciphers; images 4-5 (one key) are this entry. Re-count from the 5 Oct 2026 figures: P4 1,505/1,537, P5 199/199 = 1,704/1,736 (0.982).

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 1734 tokens, 45 types, la order 4: reading -2.244 per letter; random keys -4.662 (z 6.5); key annealed onto shuffled ciphertext best -3.016 (mean -3.057, z 28.5); annealer on the real text -2.206. Verdict: pass.

validation.notes: claimed per-occurrence score -2.244; polyphony 0.0; 3 unread tokens left out; annealer on the real text from random keys reached -2.206

outcome.method_basis: A Latin anneal on image 4 gave readable Latin at once (post recessum, sollicitabo bullam, galeotam); a second pass checked every sign against the image with the key (209 edits, look-alikes split); the same key reads the verso, image 5.
outcome.fraction_read_source: reading_p4.md: P4 1,505 of 1,537 and P5 199 of 199 cipher signs (ct_p4.txt, ct_p5.txt, measured) read as sense = 1,704/1,736; re-counted 5 Oct 2026.
